atoms.text: Rhys now wants to take you to see Wales’ landscapes. Will you go around the countryside with him?
atoms.sound: Rhys now wants to take you to see Wales’s landscapes. Will you go around the countryside with him?

instruction.text: Rhys wants to know if you recognise what Welsh landscapes look like. Select the images of landscapes in Wales.

feedback.end: Wales has a lot of beautiful mountains and three national parks. There are hills and valleys everywhere to hike around.
feedback.wrong: This is a tropical beach in the Caribbean. Welsh coasts don’t have palm trees.

instruction.text: Rhys asks if you know the names of landscapes you might see around Wales. Drag the images to the correct words.
Rhys has marked three famous natural areas in Wales on his map. Find Eryri (Snowdonia) on the map to visit it.
instruction.sound: Rhys has marked three famous natural areas in Wales on his map. Find Eryri on the map to visit it.

instruction.text: This is Eryri (Snowdonia). Find the mountain peak in the image to learn more.
instruction.sound: This is Eryri. Find the mountain peak in the image to learn more.

end.text: Eryri (Snowdonia) is a famous national park containing 15 mountains. The highest is Yr Wyddfa (Mount Snowdon), which stands at over 1,000m tall.
end.sound: Eryri is a famous national park containing 15 mountains. The highest is Er Withfa, which stands at over 1000 metres tall.

instruction.text: Find the Blue Lagoon on the map to visit it.
This is the Blue Lagoon. Find the pool in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: The Blue Lagoon is a man-made pool by the sea. It’s known for its striking blue colour, which happens because of the slate around the water.

instruction.text: Find the Bannau Brycheiniog (Brecon Beacons) on the map to visit them.
instruction.sound: Find the Ban-i Brahinyog on the map to visit them.

instruction.text: These are the Bannau Brycheiniog (Brecon Beacons). Find the clouds in the image to learn more.
instruction.sound: These are the Ban-i Brahinyog. Find the clouds in the image to learn more.

end.text: The Bannau Brycheiniog (Brecon Beacons) are a mountain range in South Wales. They contain the famous mountain Pen y Fan.
end.sound: The Ban-i Brahinyog are a mountain range in South Wales. They contain the famous mountain Penny Fan.
